stem: The curve given below represent a/an
solution: The vertical axis of the graph is labelled Cumulative frequency and is scaled from \(10\) to \(60\); the horizontal axis carries the variate, scaled from \(10\) to \(40\). The plotted points are joined by a smooth, monotonically non-decreasing S-shaped curve that starts at the origin and levels off at the total frequency \(60\). A curve obtained by plotting cumulative frequency against the class boundaries is, by definition, an ogive (a cumulative frequency curve). The other three choices are ruled out by the shape alone: a pie diagram is a circle divided into sectors, a bar diagram is a set of separated bars, and a histogram is a set of adjacent rectangles, so none of them is a curve at all. Matches option C.
